VO: I posted 41 reels before one did more than 2,000 views.
[B-ROLL: scrolling my old grid]
And it wasn't the editing.
It was the first line.
Every flop opened with me saying hi. Every hit opened mid-fight.
So I tested it. Same video, two openings, posted a week apart.
The one that started with "I lost $300 on this" did 48,000.
The one that started with "hey guys" did 900.
But here's what I didn't expect.
The comments on the big one were all people telling me their own $300 story.
That's the hook. Not a trick. A number they can feel.
Try it on your next one and tell me what it does.
